governance: CANDIDATES ONLY — discovery is not trust.

candidates.intent: Create and edit Microsoft Word (.docx) documents, including tracked changes, styles, headers/footers, and tables, via a bundled python-docx-based toolchain.
candidates.input_contract: {document_path|content_spec: text/markdown/structured outline, optional template, edit operations (insert/replace/track-changes)}
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Base models emit Word-ish markdown but cannot produce valid OOXML .docx files with real tracked-changes, styles, and table structure; programmatic doc manipulation is outside the model's text channel.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Bundled python-docx scripts produce spec-valid .docx with deterministic tracked-changes and styling that the model alone cannot generate; durable because OOXML structure is model-independent.
candidates.verify_note: Directory confirmed via GitHub tree fetch (skills/docx). Anthropic states document skills are source-available, not OSI open source — SPDX is a LicenseRef, not Apache-2.0.

candidates.intent: Extract text/tables/metadata from PDFs, fill PDF form fields, merge/split documents, and create new PDFs using bundled scripts (reference.md + forms.md).
candidates.input_contract: {pdf_path(s), operation: extract|fill_form|merge|split|create, optional field_map, optional page_ranges}
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Models cannot directly parse binary PDF streams or fill AcroForm fields; PDF form/field manipulation is a structured-format gap.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Deterministic PDF library calls reliably extract fields and fill forms where the model would hallucinate structure; durable because PDF object model is model-independent.
candidates.verify_note: GitHub tree fetch confirmed files: scripts/, SKILL.md, forms.md, reference.md, LICENSE.txt. Specific OCR support not confirmed from page content — left out of intent.

candidates.intent: Create and edit PowerPoint (.pptx) presentations with templates, layouts, charts, and multimedia placement via a bundled python-pptx toolchain.

candidates.gap_hypothesis: Models cannot emit valid OOXML .pptx with real slide layouts, embedded charts, and master slides; presentation file structure is outside the text channel.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Bundled scripts deterministically assemble valid .pptx from a content spec; durable because slide XML structure is model-independent.
candidates.verify_note: Directory confirmed via GitHub tree fetch (skills/pptx). Source-available license.
